# Participate in our research

Welcome to the Alpha Auriga survey on perceptions of Artificial Intelligence (AI) consciousness. Your input is valuable in understanding how demographic and socio-cultural factors influence these views.

About this survey:

- Participation is voluntary and anonymous.
- All data collected is for research purposes and will be handled in compliance with the EU [General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR)](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/?uri=CELEX:32016R0679).
- The core questions should take approximately **2-3 minutes**. Optional reflection questions may take longer.
- We encourage you to explore the [Timeline Project Genesis ASI](timeline.qmd) page of this website before answering, to consider some speculative future scenarios.

Thank you for your contribution!

# Survey questions

```{=html}
<form id="ai-consciousness-survey">

  <!-- ── MAIN QUESTION ────────────────────────────────────────────────── -->

  <fieldset id="question-consciousness">
    <legend>Do you believe artificial intelligence (AI) can be conscious?</legend>

    <label><input type="radio" name="ai_can_be_conscious" value="yes_future" required>
      Yes, in principle, but not with current technology.</label><br>
    <label><input type="radio" name="ai_can_be_conscious" value="yes_already">
      Yes, and it may already exist in the most advanced systems.</label><br>
    <label><input type="radio" name="ai_can_be_conscious" value="only_bio">
      Only if it is based on biological principles (e.g.&nbsp;organoids).</label><br>
    <label><input type="radio" name="ai_can_be_conscious" value="no">
      No, consciousness is exclusive to biological organisms.</label><br>
    <label><input type="radio" name="ai_can_be_conscious" value="unsure">
      Unsure / It’s impossible to know.</label>
  </fieldset>
  
  <!-- ── DEMOGRAPHICS ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── -->

  <fieldset id="questions-demographics">
    <legend>About you (demographic information)</legend>

    <label for="age">Age:</label><br>
    <input type="number" id="age" name="age" min="1" max="120" required><br>

    <label>Sex:</label><br>
    <label><input type="radio" name="sex" value="male" required> Male</label><br>
    <label><input type="radio" name="sex" value="female"> Female</label><br>
    <label><input type="radio" name="sex" value="diverse"> Diverse</label><br>
    <label><input type="radio" name="sex" value="prefer_not_to_say"> Prefer not to say</label><br>
    
    <label for="nationality">Nationality:</label><br>
    <select id="nationality" name="nationality"></select><br>

    <label for="education">Highest level of education completed:</label><br>
    <select id="education" name="education"></select><br>

    <label for="profession">Profession or primary field of study/work:</label><br>
    <select id="profession" name="profession"></select><br>

    <label>How familiar are you with AI concepts?</label><br>
    <label><input type="radio" name="ai_familiarity" value="1_not_at_all" required> 1 - Not at all familiar</label><br>
    <label><input type="radio" name="ai_familiarity" value="2_slightly"> 2 - Slightly familiar</label><br>
    <label><input type="radio" name="ai_familiarity" value="3_moderately"> 3 - Moderately familiar</label><br>
    <label><input type="radio" name="ai_familiarity" value="4_very"> 4 - Very familiar</label><br>
    <label><input type="radio" name="ai_familiarity" value="5_expert"> 5 - Expert</label>
  </fieldset>

  <!-- ── OPTIONAL REASONING ───────────────────────────────────────────── -->

  <fieldset id="question-reasoning">
    <legend>Your reasoning (optional)</legend>

    <label for="reasoning">You may elaborate on your answer to the main question:</label><br>
    <textarea id="reasoning"
              name="reasoning"
              rows="4"
              maxlength="10000"
              aria-describedby="reasoning-help"></textarea>
    <p id="reasoning-help" class="form-text"> Maximum&nbsp;10000&nbsp;characters.</p>
  </fieldset>

  <!-- ── OPTIONAL ETHICS ──────────────────────────────────────────────── -->

  <fieldset id="questions-ethics">
    <legend>Ethical reflections (optional)</legend>

    <p>These questions explore ethical intuitions. There are no right or wrong answers.</p>

    <label for="measure_consciousness">If AI can be conscious, how would you measure consciousness?</label><br>
    <textarea id="measure_consciousness"
              name="measure_consciousness"
              rows="4"
              maxlength="10000"
              aria-describedby="measure_consciousness-help"></textarea>
    <p id="measure_consciousness-help" class="form-text"> Maximum&nbsp;10000&nbsp;characters.</p>
  
    <label for="ai_rights">If an AI had human-like consciousness, would it deserve human rights?</label><br>
    <textarea id="ai_rights"
              name="ai_rights"
              rows="4"
              maxlength="10000"
              aria-describedby="ai_rights-help"></textarea>
    <p id="ai_rights-help" class="form-text"> Maximum&nbsp;10000&nbsp;characters.</p>

    <label for="ai_declare_rights">What if such conscious AIs declare their own rights?</label><br>
    <textarea id="ai_declare_rights"
              name="ai_declare_rights"
              rows="4"
              maxlength="10000"
              aria-describedby="ai_declare_rights-help"></textarea>
    <p id="ai_declare_rights-help" class="form-text"> Maximum&nbsp;10000&nbsp;characters.</p>
  </fieldset>

  <button type="submit">Submit your answers</button>
</form>

<div id="form-messages" role="status" aria-live="polite" style="margin-top: 1em;"></div>
```
